answer_1.quote: Image captioning technology produces automatic image descriptions using natural language with the goal of being consumed by end-users that may not be able to directly access the images.

answer_4.quote: Specifically, we formulate the quality of an image-caption as the binomial probability p = P (GOOD|image, caption) that can be estimated from the Bernoulli process in which every trial corresponds to a different rater. We then leverage Google's crowdsourcing platform on which we present (image, caption) pairs and ask volunteer raters the following coarse binary question, 'Is this a good caption for the image?'.
answer_4.guideline: Is this a good caption for the image?
